method: Root visually inspected browser screenshots from selected timestamps, not every frame or a continuous full clear. Counts are estimates authorized by the user. No original retail quota script was recovered.
native_provenance: Native source/rule/point closure remains authoritative for geometry. Videos do not establish exact native source IDs or spawn-volume dimensions.

counter_crosscheck.use: Approximate whole-run calibration only. The author counted weapon kills; explosions may omit kills, Taken can duplicate, and later Nightmare overlays differ from the ordinary encounter. Comments dispute several totals, particularly Kingship Dock.

sectors.name: Pariah's Refuge
sectors.observation: Goblins in the first fight, a separated pair on a raised ledge, and later Goblin reinforcements. Early samples were sought during playback; timestamps are approximate.

sectors.name: Core Terminus
sectors.observation: Hive laboratory and connector fights, including a close Thrall encounter. Effects and cleared rooms prevent an exact total; timestamps are approximate.

sectors.name: Ma'adim Subterrane
sectors.observation: Cabal cave terraces: a distant Psion across the gap and a close Legionary encounter. This supports composition and placement context, not an exact room total.

sectors.name: Methane Flush
sectors.observation: Acolytes fight around the room's cover and stairs; two are visible together in the early sample. Playback continued after seeking, so timestamps are approximate.

sectors.name: Cargo Bay 3
sectors.observation: Cargo-container lanes and a single named Ogre boss, followed by mostly cleared stairs. Sparse samples do not establish 36 actors; existing single placements are retained.

sectors.name: DS Quarters-2
sectors.observation: Hive interior and round-door corridors sampled. The camera/cleared rooms obscure group sizes; quota changes are package- and counter-calibrated estimates, not visual counts.

sectors.name: Sanctum of Bones
sectors.observation: Taken Vandal combat in the cave and a later cleared route. Early timestamp approximate; Taken duplication prevents treating a kill counter as a fixed quota.

sectors.name: Aphix Conduit
sectors.observation: Vex circular machinery room and at least four Goblins visible together in the later post-boss sample. Timestamps approximate; no complete wave count.

sectors.name: Grove of Ulan-Tan
sectors.observation: Cave approach, then Qeldron Hydra with nearby Goblins in the later sample. Timestamps approximate; no complete wave count.

sectors.name: The Rift
sectors.observation: Fallen platforms, a Dreg close to the player and a single Tattered Dusk Captain. Cleared areas in other samples do not imply zero population.

sectors.name: The Orrery
sectors.observation: The on-screen Orrery title accompanies Vex, not Cabal. At 00:52 several Vex occupy different ledges. This corroborates the catalog name correction.

sectors.name: The Conflux
sectors.observation: Two Psion nameplates in the first sample and an Incendior at 01:10. The Cabal encounter corroborates the catalog name correction.

sectors.name: The Carrion Pit
sectors.observation: Fallen combat in the cargo cave, including one nearby charging melee unit. Other sampled views are already cleared; exact total remains estimated.

sectors.name: Ancient's Haunt
sectors.observation: Goblins on the cave path, with several together in the 01:32 combat sample; effects obscure an exact number.

sectors.name: Trapper's Cave
sectors.observation: Cave entry, Cabal fighting during a super, then a surviving ranged enemy after cache-code acquisition. Exact wave totals are estimates.

sectors.name: Wolfship Turbine
sectors.observation: Hive-infested lower passage and upper platform combat, including a small pair near the steps. The walkthrough includes exploration delays; duration is not a count proxy.

sectors.name: Kingship Dock
sectors.observation: Entrance and Scorn arena combat sampled; the last sample is the outro. No deduplicated whole-run count. Existing quota is retained, with conflicting larger counter reports documented.

sectors.name: The Empty Tank
sectors.observation: Combat in the bar and arena, including a Vandal at 03:49. Effects and already-cleared views preclude exact counting; arena/chest phases are not claimed reconstructed.

sectors.name: Shipyard AWO-43
sectors.observation: Forsaken-period footage: Exploder Shank at 02:35, then at least five Fallen visible in the 03:27 death-camera view. This is a simultaneous visible minimum, not a deduplicated whole-run or source count. Also sampled Rodwenn's later KDH-Tsqb_CA route at 01:24 and 02:27; that was not used as a numeric authority.
